free_text: The patient is a 60-year-old male with a PSA of 3.0 ng/mL and a Gleason score of 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1), indicating low-grade prostate cancer. MRI showed a focal hypointense lesion in the left peripheral zone with restricted diffusion, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle involvement. Given the low-grade histology and negative advanced local features, active surveillance is recommended, balancing treatment benefit against patient preferences and comorbidities.
